item.description: Two drug dealers who played key roles in a County Lines network supplying crack cocaine and heroin across the Watford area have been jailed for a combined total of more than seven years. item.title: HAVE YOUR SAY: Council launches consultation as part of parking scheme review in Rickmansworth
item.description: A controversial Controlled Parking Zone (CPZ) in the Moneyhill area of Rickmansworth is set to be reviewed. Three Rivers District Council (TRDC) introduced the CPZ in December 2024 in response to local parking problems. However, shopkeepers shared concerns about the costs, including a £536 annual permit.
